schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (65 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-67 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates. Answer side 1-25, [match block, 10 rows], 27-66; q67 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 41, average 10, difficult 15, untagged 1.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 28 (heading, LO) 29-33; A pdf 133 (heading, keys 1-18) 134-137.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25 (q20 prints a blank -> type fill by form, key 'Fresh'); s4 '26. Match the following with appropriate answers (easy)' q26; s5 one mark q27-36 vsa; s6 two marks q37-46 sa; s7 three marks q47-56 sa; s8 four marks q57-67 la.
q3, q5 option rows wrap onto the next line ('C) Burning of / waste D) …', 'B) Wastes should be / disposed properly …') -> options re-read from the page.

q26 match: stem prints 5 rows labelled a) b) e) d) e) (e) for c) in both columns); key prints 10 rows a)-j) incl. 5 not in the stem; pairs stored for the 5 stem rows by the key's wording; flag on row e).

Keys 57-59 print a lead sentence, a sub-heading ('Purification:', 'Prevention:', 'Five ways:') and bullets -> lead sentence + bullets are steps, the sub-heading is not (addendum §5.2). Keys 62-64 print separate un-bulleted lines, one step each. Keys 47, 50, 52, 54 are wrapped prose (joined). 61, 65, 66 open with a heading line ending ':' (not a step).
q66 carries its tag on its wrapped second line; q67 prints no tag and is truncated ('paint i') -> 'no difficulty tag' + 'source notation inconsistent'; no key -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_07.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
